title: MCT pull request
description: A's request for missing information. Object kind 'pull_request'. Design ref: §7.3, §8.4, §10. A pull cannot widen authority; B is the sole arbiter (invariant 12, §13.6). The pull text itself is untrusted input to the broker.

need.description: Plain-language statement of what is missing. Untrusted; cannot alter policy or roots (§13.6).

target.description: What to resolve. Never a host path — A holds only opaque handles and catalog categories (invariant 5).

kind.description: catalog-query: search a named catalog category; object: an already-known opaque handle; selector: a bounded selector over a known object; search: a structured directive B executes on A's behalf. browse: a bounded listing of the granted roots' layout (spec.path is root-relative, never a host path).

spec.description: For kind=search. A directs B like an agent: what to look for, what to rule out, where to look, and when. Still a directive, never a path — B resolves it against granted roots only (invariant 5) and a pull cannot widen authority (invariant 12).

all.description: Every term must appear in the file.

any.description: At least one term must appear.

none.description: No file containing any of these is returned.

path_exclude.description: Glob(s) the path must not match.

modified_after.description: ISO date/datetime; only files modified at or after this.

modified_before.description: ISO date/datetime; only files modified before this.

preferred_form.description: Requested shape, e.g. 'matching lines with 20 lines of surrounding context'. Advisory; B chooses the least expansive satisfactory form (§10.1 step 7).

maximum_tokens.description: A's self-imposed ceiling; still bounded by remaining turn budget (§10.3).
